title: Leylines
content:
Leyline with blue crystalline deposits ([[04.06]] to [[05.05]]) Fire (runs from south to north beginning at [[32.32]], through [[38.28]] and ending [[44.19]])

Water (allegedly crosses [[20.20]])

Earth (allegedly crosses [[20.20]] and ends at the Eye of Gruumsch, [[26.01]])

'''The Breath of the Earth: '''The only charted air leyline in the Shrouded Lands. It begins beneath [[The Duchy of Thring]] and surfaces in the eponymous, mile-long sinkhole ([[12.28]]).
